citations.quote: All asset pricing models amount to alternative ways of connecting the stochastic discount factor to data.
The condition in a financial market in which two equivalent financial instruments or combinations of financial instruments can sell for only one price.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Stochastic Discount Factor — Intuition: framing the stochastic discount factor (SDF) as the unifying object of asset pricing — what role it plays, how it produces every linear factor pricing model as a special case, and why its existence follows from the law of one price
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Stochastic Discount Factor — Intuition
